overview: An Indian Ocean island with calm lagoons, nature parks and a large Indian-origin population, so food and culture feel familiar. Beaches are protected by reefs.
fit: Excellent for both: calm water, catamaran trips and gentle nature parks.
season: May to December is dry and mild (winter 20–25°C May–Sept; warmer Oct–Dec). January–March is hot with cyclone risk.

gettingThere.detail: Chennai to Mauritius (1-stop via Mumbai/Dubai, or Air Mauritius from Chennai seasonally)

gettingAround: Hire a car with driver; the island is about 1.5 hr end to end.

visa: Indian citizens get a free visa on arrival for up to 90 days with a return ticket and hotel booking. Fill in the Mauritius All-in-One travel form online before travel.
